title: Reserve Wheels Announces New 32” 30|XC Wheels: Big Wheels, Big Performance
content:
32 inch wheels are the latest performance revolution at the highest level of World Cup XC racing. Reserve Wheels is excited to offer Reserve 30|XC in the new 32” size as either a wheelset or rim-only.

The 32 inch 30|XC is designed to deliver the same level of stiffness and responsive ride-feel as the 29” version. To achieve this, Reserve reinforced the rim and refined the profile to accommodate the larger diameter. The result is a high-performance World Cup XC wheelset
that can stand up to real-world trail riding, backed by Reserve’s lifetime warranty. Larger wheels give riders the benefits of better rollover angle and a larger contact patch for more grip. This gives riders a smoother ride and more control.

Reserve Wheels 32″ XC Quick Hits

  • Intended use: XC Racing, Trail Riding
  • Wheel sizes: 29” and 32”
  • Rim: 30mm Internal Width / 37mm External Width
  • Hub specs: 110×15 Front /148×12 Rear
  • Disc mount: 6-Bolt
  • Weights: 1911g (Including tape, Fillmore valves, and an XD driver body)
    • Wheels: 882g Front, 1029g Rear
    • Rim only: 523g
  • Price
    • Wheelset: $1,799 USD
    • $699 USD per rim
  • Hub: DT Swiss 350
  • Spoke Count 28
  • Asymmetric Offset 3mm
  • Recommended Tire Width 2-2.4″
  • Driver Options XD, MS, HG
  • Pricing
    • $1799 US
    • $2499 CAD
    • €1799 EU
    • $2199 AUS
    • £1600 GBP

30mm Internal

A 30mm internal width delivers an ideal tire profile, providing ample sidewall support and a large contact patch. We recommend using tires between 2-2.4” wide.

Optimized Stiffness

The new refined rim profile balances radial and lateral stiffness. 28h lacing delivers the ride-feel we wanted, without adding excess weight or compromising on performance.

Lifetime Warranty

If you break a Reserve rim or Fillmore valve while out riding, we’ll replace it for free. We’re
available through email, chat or by scheduling a video call. We want to be here when you need
us most.

Learn more at reservewheels.com
